description: Read a Court decision. Returns a short summary followed by the judge’s full reasons for the decision. Use it when: I have a decision’s reference number and want to understand its reasoning. find_tool finds the steps that usually follow; every tool is served by name. Credential: none. Cost: Free.

citation.description: A neutral citation exactly as written, e.g. "[2026] CPM 4" (CPM Magistrate, CP Upper Court, CPFB High Court, CPA advisory), from call_for_judgment, get_matter or list_judgments.

name: read_judgment
